chunks: Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn `Isam al-Kulayni (may Allah be pleased with him) said: Muhammad ibn Ya`qub al-Kulayni said: `Ali ibn Muhammad, known as `Allan al-Kulayni, said: Muhammad ibn `Isa ibn `Ubayd said: I asked Abu al-Hasan `Ali ibn Muhammad al-`Askari (peace be upon them both),

regarding the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: 'And the whole Earth shall be in His Grip on the Day of Resurrection and the Heavens rolled up in His Right Hand.' He (AS) replied: 'This is a condemnation from Allah, Blessed and Exalted be He, for those who compare Him to His creation. Do you not see that He said:
And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal.

and its meaning is when they said: 'Indeed, the whole Earth is in His Grip on the Day of Resurrection and the Heavens are rolled up in His Right Hand,' just as Allah, the Mighty and High, said: 'And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal,' when they said: 'Allah has not revealed anything to a mortal' (1). Then, the Mighty and High exalted Himself from the Grip and the Right Hand, so He said: 'Glory be to Him and Exalted is He above what they associate (with Him)' (2).
And the whole Earth shall be in His Grip on the Day of Resurrection and the Heavens rolled up in His Right Hand.
And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal.
Allah has not revealed anything to a mortal.
Glory be to Him and Exalted is He above what they associate (with Him).
ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Askari interpret the 'Grip' and 'Right Hand' of Allah in Surah Az-Zumar?
ai.summary: Imam al-`Askari (AS) elucidates that the attributes of 'Grip' and 'Right Hand' in Surah al-Zumar are rhetorical concessions to those who anthropomorphize Allah, reflecting their limited understanding as noted in the phrase 'they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal.' This interpretation aligns with the Shia doctrine of *tanzih* (transcendence), where divine attributes are affirmed without likening them to creation, a theme further reinforced by the subsequent verse praising Allah's purity from what polytheists associate with Him.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 1. Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn `Isam al-Kulayni (RA) said: Muhammad ibn Ya`qub alKulayni (RA) said: `Ali ibn Muhammad, famous as `Allan al-Kulayni, said: Muhammad ibn `Isa ibn `Ubayd that I asked Abu al-Hasan `Ali ibn Muhammad al-`Askari (AS)
that the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: And the whole Earth shall be in His Grip on the Day of Resurrection and the Heavens rolled up in His Right Hand.
This is a condemnation from Allah, Blessed and Exalted be He, for those who compare Him to His Creation. Have you not see that He said:
and they do not assign to Allah the attributes due to Him
Allah has not revealed anything to a mortal,

then the Mighty and High eliminated (anthropomorphic elements of) the Grip, and the Right Side from Himself and, hence, He said: Glory be to Him, and may He be exalted above what they associate (with Him).
